title: Wish Upon the Moon III: Dreaming of Heroism
html:
Wish Upon the Moon III: Dreaming of Heroism

Quest Type

Main

Event

By Moon's Grace
Chapter
Tale of Moontree Lodge

Description

A wish to become a hero. Now that you have your own interpretation of how to become one, maybe you can help him.

Steps[]

  1. Head to the "Wishing Stall" and continue the preparations
    1. Build "Thus Says the Moon"
    2. Build "Fireworks Shop"
    3. Build "Riddle Twiddle"
  2. Decode the third Wish Tag with Patty
  3. Follow the noise
  4. Go to the secret base
  5. Search for clues with the Sensor Module
  6. Save the trapped kid
  7. Defeat the Tacet Discords
  8. Talk to Xiangli Yao

Gameplay Notes[]

  • This quest is limited.
  • When completing the "Head to the 'Wishing Stall' and continue the preparations" step, the quest name changes from Festival Festival Preparations III to Decode corrupted wishes: III.
  • When completing the "Decode the third Wish Tag with Patty" step, the quest name changes to Wish Upon the Moon III: Dreaming of Heroism.
  • Completing the quest awards the player the Rover's Journey trophy What Is a Hero and unlocks Xiangli Yao as a Lodge Wishes companion in the By Moon's Grace limited time event.

Dialogue[]

Quest Description
Try to solve the third wish.
(Talk to Patty)
Rover: The third wish... Let's see what's written this time.
Mahn's Wish
Almighty Moontree Lodge,

I have a secret to tell you.
Shhh—I might have awakened my incredible abilities like the heroes in hero plays.
Well... I'm saying this because... I could only eat one bowl of rice for lunch in the past, but now I can finish two large bowls! Also, I used to have to step on a small bench to touch the branches of Grandpa Tree, but now I only need to jump casually to touch them!
I feel like something amazing is burning inside my body. Is this what it feels like to become a great hero? I've been waiting for ages now. I wonder when I'll be able to use amazing powers like Blaze Ranger...
Moontree Lodge, oh Moontree Lodge, the adults all say that you can make any wish come true... Can you help me become a great hero?
Mahn
As you ponder the hero's wish, you hear the distant noise of children arguing about the Hero Play. Maybe they...
Quest Description
The wish that finds difficulty making a choice and seeks an answer starts to understand the weight of "choices" after you listen to it.
(Ask the children)
Xiaomo: Ugh, this again... I'm so over this cheesy old play...
Xiaomo: There are way better ones... Come on, switch it up! What about "Rainbow Mirror"? I'll be Flame Ranger, you be his sidekick being controlled by the monsters!
Li: No way... Why do I always have to be the one getting beat up? I don't wanna play the bad guy.
Li: We pinky-sweared last time, remember?! If I don't get to play as Flame Ranger, I'm not playing with you anymore.
Xiaomo: All right, all right. Let me think...
Xiaomo: Then let's do "Deep Sea Rescue." You can be Flame Ranger, and I'll be the sidekick.
Xiaomo: That good enough for you?
Li: ...Oh, I see what you're up to, Momo... trying to trick me again... In "Deep Sea Rescue," the Flame Ranger falls into the villain's trap and gets beat up at the start!
Li: So I'll still be the one getting whacked.
Li: ...Hmph. I'm gonna tell Mahn if you keep doing this. Wait till he comes back, he'll give you a knuckle sandwich.
Xiaomo: Pfft, you think telling Mahn's gonna help you? With him around, you'll never get the chance to be Flame Ranger!
Li: At least I won't get beat up by you all the time!
Do any of you know Mahn?
Xiaomo: Hey. Where did this weird grown-up with a flying bunny come from...?
Xiaomo: Mahn's not here, I'm in charge! Wanna play with us? Okay, then you can be a monster!
Xiang-LEE: Detected new name entry: "Bunny."
Xiang-LEE: Processing speed increased to 150%. Processor temperature: 90℃, 91℃, 92℃...
We're not here to play games.
Xiaomo: Ah!!! It's... it's gonna blow...!
Um... Xiangli Yao? You there?
Xiangli Yao: I'm here, don't worry. I'm overriding Xiang-LEE's processor. One moment, please.
Xiang-LEE: ...Recorded. New name entry, "Bunny."
Xiaomo: Phew. I almost wet my pants...
Li: So... You're looking for Mahn, huh?
Li: He's not here right now, but if it's important, you can tell me, and I'll pass it on to him, word for word.
Xiaomo: Pfft. Li's being a show-off again.
Xiaomo: We haven't seen Mahn for days. No way you can tell him anything.
Li: Not true! We're doing one of his favorite plays tomorrow, he'll definitely show up!
Xiaomo: We did a play yesterday and one before that. Hmph, I don't remember him showing up. Where was he?
Li: ...
Li: Ugh! You suck, Momo!
Xiaomo: Hee hee hee!
Any ideas where I can find Mahn?
Li: Well... We usually play together in the city or watch Hero Plays at the theater. Oh... and we have a secret base.
Xiang-LEE: Detected. Keyword: Secret base.
Can you tell me where it is?
Li: Hmm... Mahn says it's top secret, and we can't tell anyone.
Do you think he'll be there?
Li: Hmm... Maybe. Are you going to go look for him?
Li: But Mahn says it's top secret, and we can't tell anyone.
I'm here to help him become a great hero.
Li: What?! Really?!
Li: Um... He did mention before that there's this Flame power growing inside of him, and he's about to become a great hero just like Flame Ranger.
Li: Well... I guess you don't look like a bad person, so...
Li leans close to your ear and whispers the location of the secret base to you.
Appreciate it.
Okay, got it.
Li: Err... If you do find him, please don't tell him I told you about the secret base.
Li: Oh, oh! And remember to tell him to come back and play with us soon.
(Arrive at the designated location)
???: Take this! Flame Punch...!
???: Eek...! Get away from me!
Rover: A child's voice. Over there!
(Defeat the TDs)
Mahn: ...Whoa, that was rad! How did you do that? You gotta teach me!
Mahn: Um... Thanks for saving me, (‍‍misterText for male Rover‍/‍missText for female Rover‍‍).
Why are you out here all alone?
Mahn: I... I... It's a secret...
Mahn: Well, you did just save me from that TD so...
Mahn: All right. You can be the only grown-up that I tell.
Mahn: Ahem! I, Mahn, am about to awaken my Forte!
Your Forte?
Mahn: Well, you know. In the Hero Plays, every great hero is a Resonator with their own unique, super cool Forte.
Mahn: Some of them are born with it, and some have to journey to distant mountains and secret caves to train all alone.
Mahn: And then—"After years of training, a Tacet Mark finally appears. Forte awaken." Hehe, that's my favorite part!
Mahn: That's why I've been eating all my veggies and going to bed early lately. I want to be ready to spend the whole day at this secret base training.
Mahn: I try to practice every move I can think of from the plays, hoping my Forte will awaken soon. I've been so busy, I haven't even watched any Hero Plays lately.
So, has your Forte awakened yet?
Mahn: Um... Not really...
Mahn: But I've come up with a new plan. You know how Flame Ranger gets stronger the more danger he's in? They call it a "Forte Boost"!
Mahn: So I thought, why not find a scary monster and try to fight it?
So that Tacet Discord just now...
Mahn: Uh... That was an accident... I've no idea where it came from...
Mahn: If I'm gonna a great hero, I have to find an enemy that's even stronger than a TD.
That's too dangerous.
Mahn: But... but...
Mahn: Then, you tell me. What should I do to awaken my Forte?
Having a Forte is really so important to you?
Mahn: Absolutely, it's a must! Every hero in the plays is a Resonator with a Forte.
Mahn: Becoming a hero means I can protect all my friends. None of us will ever need to be scared again.
Mahn: Besides... being a hero is just the coolest. Every Hero Play, all my friends cheer like crazy for Flame Ranger. I don't plan on being the lame sidekick, no way.
You don't need a Forte to be a hero.
Mahn: If you know so much about it... Then what should I do? Tell me, tell me!
Exercise more.
Get plenty of rest.
Eat your vegetables.
Mahn: Ugh. You sound like my mom. Come on, don't treat me like I'm just some kid.
Rover: I do know... a few warriors. They know firsthand what it means to be a hero.
Rover: What if I write down some of their quests and daring feats for you? Real heroes, real stories... it might give you some ideas.
Mahn: Wow, really?! Are they even more awesome than the heroes in the plays??
Mahn: When will you show me these stories? I want Li and Momo to see 'em too.
Xiang-LEE: Time. Location. Event notification. The Moonlit Fair.
Rover: (The Moonlit Fair, right in the middle of the festival? It would be the perfect draw for the children in Jinzhou.)
Rover: (Thankfully, I've still got some time to get everything ready for Mahn's wish before it starts.)
Rover: How about this? The Moonlit Fair, on the day of the Moon-Chasing Festival. I'll have the stories with me. Pinky promise.
Mahn: YES!! It's a pinky promise, then!
Mahn: Can't wait to see you there!
(Talk to Xiangli Yao)
Xiangli Yao: I happened to catch the boy's wish.
Xiangli Yao: He aspires to heroism, a feat of spirit that humbles even a grown man like myself.
Xiangli Yao: His wish comes from a place of real valor and sincerity...
Xiangli Yao: However, he wishes to become a hero by awakening his Forte...
Xiangli Yao: Awakening a Forte is an intricate process, and the disparity between a Resonator and an ordinary person's abilities is significant. In our current timeframe...
Xiangli Yao: I must confess, the Academy's current research in this domain is rather limited.
Xiangli Yao: If we are to approach it from this angle, I'm afraid I may not be able to help the boy much... At least before the Moonlit Fair arrives.
You don't need a Forte to become a hero.
Xiangli Yao: ...I concur.
Xiangli Yao: Thinking back on a few scenes from the Hero Plays... Flame Ranger did not rely solely on his Forte and abilities to achieve his heroic feats.
Xiangli Yao: Courage, perseverance, and support from his companions were all indispensable elements.
Xiangli Yao: Your idea of finding a real-life role model to show the boy a more grounded version of heroism... is indeed a viable approach.
Xiangli Yao: So, have you decided who this hero should be?
Jinhsi?
Xiangli Yao: A fine suggestion. I have always admired the Magistrate of Jinzhou.
Xiangli Yao: However, any form of recording within the City Hall would require prior clearance. With the Moonlit Fair on the horizon, time may not allow it.
Jiyan?
Xiangli Yao: A fine suggestion. I have always admired General Jiyan.
Xiangli Yao: However, any form of recording involving the Midnight Rangers would require prior clearance. With the Moonlit Fair on the horizon, time may not allow it.
Any suggestions?
Xiangli Yao: ...Actually, the person I have in mind embodies courage, perseverance, and leadership, with steadfast companions who would stand by (‍‍himText for male Rover‍/‍herText for female Rover‍‍), never backing down even in the face of powerful enemies...
Xiangli Yao: There's no need to look far, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). You are the most suitable candidate.
Me?
I'm no role model.
Xiangli Yao: Your actions alone in saving Jinzhou have earned you the title of hero.
Xiangli Yao: A true hero is defined not by grand gestures but by their actions.
Xiangli Yao: Authenticity is key. Just chronicle your daily life, and let your true self shine through.
All right.
I'll give it a try.
Xiangli Yao: The Pangu Terminal can record your daily activities. Before you begin I'll make some enhancements to provide you with additional assistance.
Xiangli Yao: Thank you for your hard work so far, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). It will take some time to analyze the fourth wish. I'll contact you after it is complete.
Xiangli Yao: The Moonlit Fair is approaching... I hope that all the wishes in the Moontree Lodge will soon come true.
(Quest Complete)
